m.title: Binary Search · worked example
m.q: Trace binary search for 23 in [3,7,11,15,19,23,27,31]. Show low, mid and high. [5 marks]
st: The list is sorted; low=0 and high=7.
mid=(0+7) DIV 2=3; value 15 is less than 23, so low becomes 4.
mid=(4+7) DIV 2=5; value 23 matches. Found at index 5. [5]
